title: precision_recall_table
description: Computes TP/P (recall) and FP/P averaged over seeds for each (sim_setup, alg_conf) cell.

ids.description: List of algorithm configuration IDs (columns in the table).

graph_type.description: Graph type(s) to evaluate. One table is produced per graph type.

row_labels.description: Custom row labels for the heatmap and CSV, one per sim_setup. If null, auto-generated labels are used.

latex_row_labels.description: Custom row labels for the LaTeX table. May contain LaTeX code. Falls back to row_labels then auto-generated labels if null.

latex.description: If true, also write a LaTeX table to table.tex.

annot.description: If true, write the value as text in each cell of the heatmap.

show_title.description: If true, show the title above the heatmap.

show_cbar.description: If true, show the colorbar to the right of the heatmap.

figsize.description: Figure size as [width, height] in inches. If null, matplotlib auto-sizes.

format.description: Output file format for the heatmap.
